g.text: Only the BBO core may reject a post-only order for crossing
the lane only routes it; the BBO core checks it against the live book
step s: crosses the live book?
Reject or Ack (gated on released_step ≥ s)
the lane cannot reject on its own: its
snapshot can be stale in either direction,
and its version is not logged (ARC-D6)
